description: Patreon OAuth 2.0. Obtain an access token by completing the OAuth flow at https://www.patreon.com/oauth2/authorize and exchanging the code at POST /api/oauth2/token.

scopes.users: Read access to the user's public profile information.
scopes.my-campaign: Read access to the creator's campaign and rewards.
scopes.pledges-to-me: Read access to pledges made to the creator's campaign.
